description:
This is a non-personnel services contract to provide Courier Services for the Orlando VA Health Care System.  The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to perform Courier Services as defined in this Performance Work Statement.
